newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kugelfischer 4-mo net profit down, sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kugelfischer 4-mo net profit down, sales up.

text.p: German ball bearings manufacturer FAG Kugelfischer AG said on Thursday it made a group net profit of 29.2 million marks in the first four months of 1997, down from the year-earlier period but up by eight million marks on an adjusted basis.
Kugelfischer did not give a profit figure for the year-earlier which it said contained extraordinary income from the sale of real estate.

Stripping out that income from the year-earlier result resulted in the eight million-mark profit rise in the four months to April 30 this year, Kugelfischer said in a mandatory statement released ahead of its annual shareholders meeting today.
Sales rose six percent to 991 million marks in the first four months and incoming orders rose 21.7 percent to 1.07 billion marks, the company said.
Kugelfischer 4-mo net profit down, sales up
Profit from ordinary activities rose to 37.5 million marks from a comparable result of 31.8 million, the company said.
"From today's point of view FAG expects further improvements in sales, net profit and cash flow in the current year," the company said.
